Welcome to glom! A couple of things before you hit "Create":

glom's core API is kept deliberately small and composable. If this PR
adds or changes functionality (especially a new specifier type), take a
moment to read about extending glom first; many extensions work great
without living in core:
https://glom.readthedocs.io/en/latest/custom_spec_types.html

The code gets reviewed either way. What I can't reconstruct after the
fact is the human side: why you cared enough to open this, and what you
learned along the way. That's worth more every year, so this template
asks for it up front. PRs that skip the sections below tend to get
closed without much ceremony.
-->
